# ANALYSIS: Sniper Real Fills Grinder Keeper #1 Analysis

**Filed:** 2026-07-23  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The strategy attempts to capture bearish momentum by entering on SPY level breaks with volume confirmation and specific candlestick body requirements, using a tiered exit strategy with profit locking.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers when SPY breaks below a defined level (e.g., prior low, trendline) with volume at least vol_mult times average and a candle body of at least body_min_cents, confirmed by min_stars signals. Exit uses a profit lock that arms at profit_lock_threshold_pct and trails by profit_lock_stop_offset_pct, with initial stop at premium_stop_pct, TP1 at tp1_premium_pct (selling tp1_qty_fraction of position), and a runner target at runner_target_pct.
